A '''trade guild''' was active in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. They operated out of an [[Ithorian Herdship]]. [[Smuggler/Legends|Smuggler]] [[Murr Danod]] was one of their employees, and he dealt in morally gray items.
